notes: The prompt says roleplay outright and its whole content is picking any animal and any breed and then dressing it, which is Roleplay & Avatar Sim's Morph Roleplay — customisation without property, so no housing model is needed. The answer says the ten named biomes (City, Forest, Jungle, Desert, Beach, Plains, Farm, Mountain, Snow, Rainforest) are separate places reached only through the Teleport button, so I substituted hub-portals for the preset's settlement-static and kept its P4: the teleport button is the portal hub and each biome is its own zone. I rejected world-open-biomes because nothing here scales with distance — the biomes are themed roleplay destinations, not a difficulty gradient. Deciding without a user: the City and Farm supply settlement-density, Mountain and Snow supply tiered terrain relief, the Beach brings water whose CHECK should pass as a shoreline, no interiors were added because nobody said you go inside, and the closet, settings, quality and donate buttons are UI with no layout footprint.
